notes.title: Android version now included!
notes.notes:
If you already own Ice Cream Factory, you may have noticed a downloadable update for the game as of late. 

This is because from now on, the Android version of the game is bundled with the PC release playable on Steam! Players with Android phones or tablets can drag the APK file to those devices and play Ice Cream Factory directly on there!

To locate the APK file, go to "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Ice Cream Factory\Ice Cream Factory" on your computer. 

To install the game, simply locate the APK on your device (whether it be through File Manager or however other method you can use to look through files) and click on it to trigger the installation process. After it's installed, you'll be able to play on the go!
